targets.expr:
100 * (1 -
  sum by (subsystem) (
    label_replace(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{zoc_feature=~"vc_filtered|vc_filtered_ts_sampled", tps_system="cics", zos_sysplex=~"$sysplex|^$", zos_sysplex_name=~"$sysplex|^$", mainframe_lpar_name=~"$lpar", service_name=~"$service", span_name=~".*(${subsystem:pipe}).*"}[max($__rate_interval,2m)]), "subsystem", "CICS", "", "")
    or
    label_replace(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{zoc_feature=~"vc_filtered|vc_filtered_ts_sampled", db_system_name="ibm.db2", zos_sysplex=~"$sysplex|^$", zos_sysplex_name=~"$sysplex|^$", mainframe_lpar_name=~"$lpar", service_name=~"$service", span_name=~".*(${subsystem:pipe}).*"}[max($__rate_interval,2m)]), "subsystem", "DB2", "", "")

    label_replace(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{zoc_feature=~"vc_filtered|vc_filtered_ts_sampled", messaging_system="ibmmq", zos_sysplex=~"$sysplex|^$", zos_sysplex_name=~"$sysplex|^$", mainframe_lpar_name=~"$lpar", service_name=~"$service", span_name=~".*(${subsystem:pipe}).*"}[max($__rate_interval,2m)]), "subsystem", "MQ", "", "")

  /
  sum by (subsystem) (
    label_replace(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{zoc_feature="received", tps_system="cics", zos_sysplex=~"$sysplex|^$", zos_sysplex_name=~"$sysplex|^$", mainframe_lpar_name=~"$lpar", service_name=~"$service", span_name=~".*(${subsystem:pipe}).*"}[max($__rate_interval,2m)]), "subsystem", "CICS", "", "")
